data.name: Humayn
data.gender_notes: Humayn is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Humayn is derived from the Arabic word 'haymana' which means to be kind, generous and beautiful. The name Humayn carries the meaning “A beautiful and kind person” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Humayn usually hope their child will grow to embody a beautiful and kind person and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quran mentions several qualities of a believer such as kindness, generosity, and beauty, all of which are embodied in the name Humayn.
data.etymology: Humayn belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A beautiful and kind person.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humayn total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: همين
in_arabic.meaning: الهمين من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الرفعة و العزة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الهمين هو اسم مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'هم' و يعني الرفعة و العزة و الهمة العالية. و قد ورد ذكره في بعض الأحاديث النبوية و الآيات القرآنية التي تشير إلى الهمة العالية و الصبر على الشدائد. يعتبر الهمين من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية و قيمية عالية في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: ہمیں
in_urdu.meaning: ہمیں ایک ایسا نام ہے جو عزت و سربلندی کا مطلب رکھتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہمیں نام عربی زبان کے جذر 'هم' سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے عزت، سربلندی اور بلند همتی۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ صبر، استقامت اور روحانی ترقی کی بات کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیا کے مسلم معاشرے میں ہمیں نام کی روایتی اہمیت ہے اور یہ اکثر ان بچوں کو دیا جاتا ہے جو بہادر اور طاقتور ہونے کی امید کی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हमीन
in_hindi.meaning: हमीन नाम उच्च और महान अर्थों से जुड़ा है
in_hindi.long_meaning: हमीन नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है उच्चता, महानता और उच्च आत्मा। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह आध्यात्मिक विकास, धैर्य और साहस की बात करता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में हमीन नाम का बहुत सम्मान किया जाता है और यह नाम अक्सर उन बच्चों को दिया जाता है जो उच्च आदर्शों और मूल्यों के साथ जीने की प्रेरणा देते हैं।

in_pashto.name: همین
in_pashto.meaning: همین د عزت او لوړتیا یو نوم دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: همین نوم د عربي ژبې د 'هم' ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او معنی یې د عزت، لوړتیا او لوړه موخه ده. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، همین نوم ډیر اهمیت لري ځکه چې دا د صبر، زغم او روحاني ودې خبرې کوي. دا نوم اکثره د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې غواړي د لوړو موخو او ارزښتونو سره ژوند وکړي.

in_english.name: Humayn
in_english.meaning: Humayn means high esteem, nobility and high ambition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Humayn is derived from the Arabic root 'hum' and signifies high esteem, nobility, and high ambition. It holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, reflecting attributes of patience, perseverance, and elevated spiritual aspirations. Historically, the name has been associated with positive personality traits such as leadership, courage, and determination. Across Muslim cultures, Humayn remains a revered name symbolizing honor and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Humayn is a reminder of the Islamic virtues of kindness, generosity, and beauty. In many Islamic communities, children with this name are encouraged to embody these characteristics, which can lead to positive social interactions and strong relationships within families and larger communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Humayn can be seen as a reminder of the importance of inner beauty and kindness. As the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "The best of you are those who have the best manners and character." (Bukhari and Muslim). By striving to live up to the spiritual meaning of the name, individuals can cultivate a stronger connection with God and live a more fulfilled and meaningful life.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Humayn serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of a beautiful and kind person.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Humayn ibn Abd al-Muttalib (533-566 AD) was the third son of the founder of the Islamic state, Prophet Muhammad (570-632 AD). He was the second caliph of the Rashidun Caliphate, succeeding his father, Abu Bakr (573-634 AD). He ruled from 624 to 632 AD.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Humayn remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: Fatima Humayn, a teacher in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, shares that their name Humayn meaning "A beautiful and kind person" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
